title: Your first graph, with no model at all
hook: Three nodes, no model, no GPU. See what a node, a wire and an output node are by making them work in under a second.

verified.claim: EmptyImage splits the colour number into red, green and blue, each divided by 255.
ImageInvert computes 1 minus the value and leaves any alpha channel alone.
A graph with no output node is refused with prompt_no_outputs.
Both graphs in this lesson pass validate_prompt and ran on a CPU here.
Dropping an API-format file on the canvas opens it: the front end's isApiJson and loadApiJson handle it.
verified.ref: src/scripts/app.ts in the ComfyUI front end, fetched 2026-11-01

unchecked: We read that front-end code on its main branch. We did not test dropping a file by hand in the version installed here.
